name: dstack
install:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Idempotent Cloud Agent bootstrap for the dstack monorepo.
# Prepares the Rust workspace, public SDK toolchains, and the guest-agent simulator.
# Also checks out the private Eggomi repo once the environment token includes it.
# Guest OS image builds (mkosi/Yocto) and KVM/QEMU no-TEE flows are intentionally excluded.
set -euo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential \
  ca-certificates \
  clang \
  cmake \
  curl \
  git \
  jq \
  libclang-dev \
  libprotobuf-dev \
  libssl-dev \
  musl-tools \
  pkg-config \
  protobuf-compiler \
  python3 \
  python3-pip \
  python3-venv

if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | \
    sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none --profile minimal --no-modify-path
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.cargo/bin/rustup" /usr/local/bin/rustup
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.cargo/bin/cargo" /usr/local/bin/cargo
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.cargo/bin/rustc" /usr/local/bin/rustc
fi

rustup toolchain install 1.92 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy,rust-analyzer
rustup target add --toolchain 1.92 \
  wasm32-unknown-unknown \
  x86_64-unknown-linux-musl \
  thumbv6m-none-eabi

if ! command -v pdm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -sSL https://pdm-project.org/install-pdm.py | python3 -
fi
if [[ -x "${HOME}/.local/bin/pdm" ]]; then
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.local/bin/pdm" /usr/local/bin/pdm
fi

repo_root="$(pwd)"
if [[ ! -f "${repo_root}/dstack/Cargo.toml" ]]; then
  echo "dstack/Cargo.toml not found; run this script from the repository root" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cargo fetch --manifest-path dstack/Cargo.toml
cargo fetch --manifest-path sdk/rust/Cargo.toml

# Two jobs keeps peak rustc memory inside a 16GB desktop VM.
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS="${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS:-2}" \
  cargo build --manifest-path dstack/Cargo.toml --release -p dstack-guest-agent-simulator

install -Dm755 dstack/target/release/dstack-simulator sdk/simulator/dstack-simulator

# repositoryDependencies puts tzarebczan/eggomi on the Cloud Agent GitHub token.
# The Cursor app can be allowed on all repos while this token still omits it.
eggomi_dir="${HOME}/eggomi"
if ! gh api repos/tzarebczan/eggomi --jq .full_name >/dev/null; then
  echo "github token cannot read tzarebczan/eggomi" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ -d "${eggomi_dir}/.git" ]]; then
  git -C "${eggomi_dir}" fetch --prune origin
  git -C "${eggomi_dir}" pull --ff-only
else
  rm -rf "${eggomi_dir}"
  gh repo clone tzarebczan/eggomi "${eggomi_dir}"
fi

echo "dstack cloud install complete"
echo "eggomi checkout: ${eggomi_dir}"
rustc --version
cargo --version
pdm --version
protoc --version
